get.description:
Expose normalized features from one admitted session catalog.

This endpoint is a presentation projection only. It never discovers a
source by filename, initializes the YAML source registry, or reads a
fixed village directory.

List artifact references present in the current checkpoint.

The client uses this index before reading payloads, so an absent artifact
is represented as a normal state instead of a burst of expected 404s.

get.description:
Return the declared topic dependency graph used by the planner.

This is configuration metadata only. It does not infer dependencies from
report text and it does not claim that any node has been executed.

schema.title: Response Get Dependency Graph Api V1 Planning Dependency Graph Get

post.description:
Answer a spatial question through one bounded evidence boundary.

The endpoint is read-only from the user's perspective.  It may hydrate
the in-process session context, but the response is composed from the
report/L1, session KG, bundle and optional external retrieval pipeline;
geometry remains bundle-authoritative and is returned only as a feature
reference inside ``EvidencePacket``.

get.summary: List persisted planning projects and sessions
get.description:
Return small, restart-safe metadata for the planning history sidebar.

The database layer already owns session persistence. This endpoint only
exposes identifiers and timestamps; user-provided village text, task text,
constraints, and uploaded content remain server-side.

Return persisted step reports and stage coverage for one session.

This is a read-only API projection. It exposes saved stage summaries and
artifact references; it does not expose hidden model reasoning or create
any fallback planning output.

CurrentSourceRaster.title: CurrentSourceRaster
CurrentSourceRaster.description:
Safe public manifest for a configured raster source.

The local filesystem path is intentionally not exposed. Consumers use the
manifest to explain availability while terrain analysis reads the raster
through the backend catalog.

FeatureEvidenceRef.title: FeatureEvidenceRef
FeatureEvidenceRef.description:
A reference to a source feature; it never embeds executable geometry.

``geometry_ref`` is opaque until GROUND resolves it.  DATA references use
``resource:<dataset_ref>:<source_feature_ref>``.

HistoryProjectList.description: Stable response for the restart-safe planning history list.

HistorySession.description: Minimal persisted-session metadata exposed to the history sidebar.

ResumeRequest.title: ResumeRequest
ResumeRequest.description: Explicit cursor command for active interrupts or checkpoint forks.

SourceFeatureIdentity.title: SourceFeatureIdentity
SourceFeatureIdentity.description:
Identity for a generic DATA source record.

This is the canonical identity on the V2 path.  A source feature may be
unnamed and is never required to carry a cadastral BSM.  ``entity_refs``
live on :class:`FeatureEvidenceRef` because one source record can be
linked to multiple cognition entities during reconciliation.

SpatialCognitionEvidence.description: KG + bundle spatial cognition, separate from factual evidence.
